args.prompt: SLOW raises the book into frame; FAST's double-take. The approved stoop: SLOW holds up 'THINKING, FAST AND SLOW' by 'DANIEL KAHNEMAN'; FAST points at himself, offended. Camera: Medium two-shot on the stoop. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, saturated colors, energetic limited animation with smear frames, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
